CustomField.label: Skywave Demo Seed
CustomField.description: True for exactly one Contact: the curated "demo seed" that Skywave_ResolveSession falls back to when a chat conversation has no MessagingEndUser ContactId and no website-side Contact (Skywave_Conversation_Id__c match). Used by the secondary Experience Cloud chat page that doesn't carry our deviceId prechat field, so the agent still gets a populated survey + booking history instead of an empty placeholder.
